verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents a plan-first mode for larger features: the team aligns and picks options and mockups before anything is built, then hands the plan off as an implementation task. That is a pre-code review step, but it rests on one thin docs line and is scoped to larger features. Diff, screenshot and summary reviews (docs-20/21) happen after code exists, so they do not count toward plan approval. Missing for 10: an explicit approve/reject gate on an agent-generated plan, detail on plan contents and editing, plan-first review for all changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made

citations.quote: For larger features, plan first and align as a team. Pick options and mockups before anything is built, then hand the plan off as one implementation task.
